Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearsight.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short-term credits request while PO is processing

Hi Ben,

We're excited to continue the pilot with Redwood — thanks for the account set-up last week. Our finance team is running a temporary freeze on new vendor spend while the PO is being routed through procurement and legal; looks like it won't clear until late next week (PO expected by 3/24).

Would Redwood be willing to issue a short-term credit/voucher or extend our trial window for ~10–14 days so our evaluation doesn't stall? We're close to a technical decision but need to keep the sandbox alive to finish latency and scale tests.

Happy to share the PO tracker or have procurement confirm timelines — copied them here.

Thanks,
Samantha Green
Head of ML Platforms
Clearsight AI

Attachments: none

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short-term credits request while PO is processing

Hi Samantha — thanks for the heads up and glad the pilot is going well.

We can help avoid the evaluation gap. I can provision a 'warm-start' credit for 14 days (up to $2,000 in usage) while procurement completes. I'll need approval from sales ops to confirm the voucher amount and an S-rep sign-off; copied Marissa who handles these approvals.

If that works, can you confirm:
- Billing contact and PO number when available
- Expected clearance date (you mentioned 3/24)
- Any usage caps we should enforce for the voucher

Once Marissa gives the OK I'll send a PDF voucher and a HubSpot note linking the credit to RDW-2027-0489.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Direct: (555) 412-0198
